campaign.description: 302 generated designs. Three design arms. Five BCMA states. Explore the evidence from first screening to confidence, physics, and modeled escape.
limitations: Generated inventory includes native rejections; native acceptance is not final nomination.
194 generated designs have no common Fast score. Missing scores are null, never zero.
Fast confidence and ipSAE are descriptive predictions, not measured affinity or binding probability.
All 14 candidate AF2 results are diagnostic because target conformation remains confounded.
B5/L10 reproduce the AF2 target-conformation issue; this does not establish biological nonbinding.
WT is the only predicted campaign state. Variant resistance and held-out comparison remain unevaluated.
Membrane accessibility, exposed hydrophobicity and experimental binding were not established.
Full sequences, molecular coordinates, raw PAE and model weights are not included.

methods.af2_diagnostics: All 14 candidate AF2 predictions are excluded from active ranking because of a shared target-conformation issue reproduced by B5/L10 controls. This does not demonstrate biological nonbinding. Native scalar pLDDT is unavailable and is not inferred.
methods.confidence_formula: C = 100 × [0.5 × native ipTM + 0.5 × min(ipSAE binder→target, ipSAE target→binder)]
methods.current_rank: The 108 scored binders use the provisional Fast confidence score C only. This is not the final combined rank. The other 194 inventory members remain unranked.
methods.escape_controls: WT is a baseline and P33S is a variant control, displayed outside the competitive Red ranks. A future P33S modeled-escape count is not forced to zero. R27P, S30del and P34del are clinical reagent-specific challenges; the clinical evidence does not establish escape from these new binders.
methods.escape_eligibility: Require reviewed model-supported WT binding, reviewed WT and mutant target integrity, accepted structures and chemistry, matched binder identity and evaluator settings, and complete confidence/physics evidence. A failed or missing computation is unknown. The rule not being met does not prove retained biological binding.
methods.escape_rule: Modeled escapes use an explicitly uncalibrated joint-decline rule. Each of native ipTM and both directional ipSAE values must fall by at least max(0.10, 25% of its WT value). Variant interface energy must be less favorable than WT, and its fixed-reference physics percentile must fall by at least 25 points.
methods.final_rank: Final ranks are per antigen, using the common held-out Boltz prediction and one reviewed beta_nov16 physics replicate. Fast screening and confounded AF2 diagnostics are not substituted for that final protocol.
methods.limitations: Scores are computational utilities, not binding probabilities or measured affinities. Confidence components are correlated. Rosetta energies are protocol- and interface-size-dependent; percentiles depend on the frozen cohort. Family-related binders are not independent replicates. Ranking is not final nomination or proof of design-method superiority.
methods.minimum_ipsae: The campaign uses the conservative minimum of two directional ipSAE fields. Canonical ipSAE reports the maximum; canonical published cutoffs are not applied to this custom minimum.
methods.missing_and_ties: A missing, failed, confounded or unreviewed required component leaves the score unavailable. No zero filling or weight redistribution. Rank scores rounded to six decimals with shared competition ranks (1, 2, 2, 4); stable IDs order ties without breaking them. Display scores to two decimals.
methods.physics_formula: P(E) = 100 × [number of frozen WT energies > E + 0.5 × number equal to E] / N
methods.physics_reference: Lower interface_dG_REU is better. Freeze the complete WT nominee reference cohort, excluding published controls, before inspecting energies. Use that same reference for every variant. At least two distinct energies are required; do not drop failed members to create a favorable subset.
methods.red_formula: Red score = 100 × modeled escapes / N eligible WT-supported binders, with complete coverage of the same frozen panel
methods.reproducibility: Download the public snapshot and scalar evidence. Source hashes, cohort identities and ranking source are retained; no new predictions or molecular rescoring were performed for this site.
